summary: FlowSummary acceptance checks pass: PV/grid/autarky display exactly API-rounded values; battery equals captured SoC × configured 9.6 kWh; sources/labels/units and all 16 unique IDs verified. Two additional polling cycles succeed. No dashboard/summary overflow at 1920x800 or 390x844, no runtime exceptions. critical.issue: Existing autarky_pct uses (PV minus export) / household consumption, not household demand covered without grid import. Actual response: consumption 5.948 kWh, grid import 3.022 kWh, reported autarky 18.8%; household-demand definition gives 49.2%. Frontend correctly repeats the API value, but renaming it 'Autarkie heute' does not fix its meaning. Reproduced on initial test and retry.

Account for measured grid charging separately if that is supported; do not use PV-minus-export as household supply when DC battery charging/discharging exists.

Update the demo-mode PV & Netz details text that still says device YDay values are cumulative since midnight. This contradicts mocks.py and the newly corrected summary; code-review observation, not separately clicked in browser.

critical_code_review_comments: routes.py lines 358-360 compute autarky from self_consumption_kwh = pv_kwh - grid_export_kwh. PV includes DC MPPT charging while house demand includes battery discharge, so that numerator is not household self-supply. This existing formula is inconsistent with conventional Autarkie and with the instantaneous household-coverage formula in FlowSummary lines 45-46.
Dashboard.jsx line 205 claims YDay counters accumulate since midnight even in demo mode, although mocks.py lines 61/110 generate sun-intensity-dependent instantaneous pseudo-counters.

rca of the issue: GET /api/today returns 18.8% = (1.354 PV - 0.238 export) / 5.948 household kWh × 100. Grid-independent household demand yields (5.948 - 3.022) / 5.948 × 100 = 49.2%. snapshots integrate correctly under existing UTC tests, but routes.py uses the wrong numerator for household autonomy. Battery discharge and DC PV charging make PV self-consumption distinct from household self-supply. Correct the metric definition/backend formula; leave frontend API mapping unchanged.
